optimization_analysis: Merged SEM_FILTER and SEM_EXTRACT into a single SEM_EXTRACT operator. The filter condition 'mentions a Tesla model' is now embedded as a prompt constraint in the extraction: 'only if the document mentions a Tesla model'. This eliminates one LLM call per document while preserving correctness—documents without Tesla mentions will produce empty lists, which the downstream FILTER removes.

optimized_semantic_plan.program: SCAN_DOCS(NHTSA, investigation_reports, selector='*.txt', columns=[file_id, body]) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract every NHTSA recall number cited in the body, but only if the document explicitly mentions a Tesla model (e.g., Model 3, Model S, Model Y, Model X). Accept formats like 12V-491, 23V085, 23V085000. Normalize to the long form and deduplicate. If no Tesla model is mentioned, return an empty list.', out_schema={cited_recall_numbers: list[string]}, input_bindings={text: body}) -> FILTER(len(cited_recall_numbers) >= 1) -> PROJECT([file_id, cited_recall_numbers])
